title: Sandstorm
author: Christopher Rowe
note: conf=0.93; Full title on print edition: "Sandstorm: A Forgotten Realms Novel" (Wizards of the Coast, March 2011, ISBN 9780786957422). The Forgotten Realms Wiki explicitly describes it as a stand-alone novel; it belongs to the shared Forgotten Realms setting but not to any numbered sub-series. It was Rowe's debut novel. The filename's "Not A Series ... 0 of 0" is consistent with standalone status.
